name: Electric Kettle & Water Jug
description: Domestic electrical water heating appliances and immersion jugs with automatic cut-off.

applicable_standards.title: Particular Requirements for Electric Kettles and Jugs
General Safety Requirements for Household Electrical Appliances

scheme_description: Factory audit + Product sample testing at BIS recognized lab + Continuous in-house QC

qco_status.ministry: Ministry of Heavy Industries & Public Enterprises

documents_required: Form-V (Application for Grant of Licence)
Proof of Factory Registration / MSME Udyam Registration
Process Flowchart & Manufacturing Machinery List
List of In-house Quality Testing Equipment with Calibration Certificates
Appointment of Competent Quality Control Personnel (Technical Bio-data)
Factory Layout Map & Raw Material Storage Plan
Raw Material Test Certificates (Heating element, Thermostat, Cable with ISI mark)
Bank Guarantee / Indemnity Bond for Marking Fee

name: Protective Helmet for Two-Wheeler Riders
description: Crash protective headgear for riders of two-wheel motor vehicles, full face and open face.

applicable_standards.title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders - Specification

scheme_description: Rigorous drop-impact compliance, penetration resistance, dynamic retention tests

qco_status.order_name: Helmet for Two-Wheeler Riders (Quality Control) Order
qco_status.ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

key_tests.name: Impact Absorption Test (7.5 m/s drop onto anvils, Peak < 300g)
Penetration Resistance Test (3.0 kg conical punch drop)

documents_required: Form-V BIS License Application
Factory Registration / DIC / Udyam Certificate
Mould specifications and Shell resin certification (ABS / Polycarbonate Grade)
EPS Liner Density Test Records (High density energy absorption)
Visor Impact & Optical Test Reports
In-House Test Equipment: Headforms, Accelerometer, Drop Tower, Drop Punch
Quality Control Manual and Calibrated Testing Log

name: Children Toys (Electric & Non-Electric)
description: Toys for play, education, or recreation intended for children under 14 years.
scheme_description: Mandatory physical safety + elemental toxicology analysis at recognized labs

key_tests.name: Sharp Edges Mandrel & Sharp Points Tester
Heavy Metal Migration (Lead < 90 mg/kg, Cd < 75 mg/kg)

documents_required: Form-V Online Application via e-BIS Portal
Certificate of Incorporation / MSME Certificate
Toy Design Specifications and Age Grading Declaration (e.g. 0-3 yrs / 3+ yrs)
Raw Material Polymer Safety Data Sheets (Food-grade/Non-toxic pigments)
List of Manufacturing Moulds and Ultrasonic Welding Machines
In-house Drop Test Stand, Torque Meter, Sharp Edge Tester
List of Qualified QC Inspectors
